name: Wild Dwarf
traits: The Dur Authalar are Small Humanoids (Dwarf). +2 Constitution, −2 Charisma. Darkvision 60 ft.
Small gives +1 on attacks and AC, +4 Hide, −4 grapple, and three-quarters of the Medium carrying limits. Use Small weapons.
Land speed 20 ft. The 3.5 dwarf movement rule keeps that speed in medium or heavy armor or under a medium or heavy load.
Dwarf stability gives +4 on ability checks to resist bull rush or trip when firmly grounded.
+3 racial on saves against poison, +4 racial against disease, and +2 racial against spells and spell-like abilities.
Fire resistance 5. Immune to Wild Dwarf knockout poison. Poison Use prevents accidental self-poisoning during application to a weapon.
Proficient with handaxe and blowgun in place of dwarven waraxe and urgrosh familiarity. +1 racial attack bonus against orcs and goblinoids and +4 dodge AC against giants.
The species entry removes stonecunning and the standard stone or metal Appraise and Craft bonuses.
Common, Dwarven, and the home-region language are automatic. The revised Chult table grants Chultan and offers Draconic, Goblin, Ignan, Shaaran, and Tashalan as bonus languages.
Favored class Barbarian. No racial Hit Dice. Level adjustment +0. Effective character level equals class levels.
This 3.5 adaptation uses the 2003 playable traits, revised core Dwarf rules, and the revised Chult region.
